Request fixtures captured from one gated run of the protocol binding against the installed Gemini runtime (gemini-cli 0.61.0, launched as `gemini --acp`), through Server.Exchanges().

Each fixture is the request body reduced to the members the generateContent codec reads. The codec reads: tools[].functionDeclarations[].name, .parametersJsonSchema (else .parameters); contents[].parts[].functionResponse.name and .response; generationConfig.responseSchema and generationConfig.responseJsonSchema. The model and the streaming flag come from the request target, not the body.

Files, with the request target and the credential header as captured:

gemini-first-turn.json        POST /v1beta/models/gemini-3.8-flash:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse    x-goog-api-key = sentinel
gemini-second-turn.json       POST /v1beta/models/gemini-3.8-flash:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse    x-goog-api-key = sentinel; carries one functionResponse (name read_file, id read_file_1790752286619_0)
gemini-auxiliary.json         POST /v1beta/models/gemini-3.5-flash-lite:generateContent             x-goog-api-key = sentinel; the routing classifier, no tools, non-streaming

Decoded values a test can assert:
- first turn: 15 tools, first declared update_topic, read_file among them with required property file_path (type string); no tool results; streaming true; model gemini-3.8-flash.
- second turn: the same 15 tools; exactly one tool result, Name read_file, Output the compact re-encoding of {"output":"nonce-12d198c2596b0a12\n"}; streaming true.
- auxiliary: no tools; response schema declares complexity_reasoning and complexity_score with types spelled STRING and INTEGER (upper case), the top-level type spelled OBJECT; streaming false; model gemini-3.5-flash-lite.

Members dropped from every fixture:
- systemInstruction (whole member)
- contents[].parts[].text
- contents[].parts[].functionCall
- contents[].parts[].thoughtSignature
- tools[].functionDeclarations[].description
- generationConfig.temperature, generationConfig.topP, generationConfig.topK, generationConfig.thinkingConfig (whole generationConfig member dropped from both turn fixtures, where it held nothing else)
- generationConfig.responseMimeType (auxiliary fixture only)

Consequences of the reduction: the text parts and the model's functionCall part in contents remain as empty objects, so the second-turn fixture holds three contents entries with two, one and one parts, the last one the functionResponse. No captured header, sentinel, absolute path or system text remains in a fixture.

Members kept although the codec does not read them: contents[].role, functionResponse.id, and the schema descriptions inside parametersJsonSchema and responseJsonSchema, because those are part of the schema exactly as declared.


Further request fixtures captured from one gated run of the scripted-model binding against each installed major of a second runtime (OpenCode 1.18.33 and OpenCode 2.0.20, each launched as `opencode`), through Server.Exchanges(). The second runtime reaches the endpoint through its bundled Google provider on the same wire, and both majors declare tools, so neither sent an auxiliary request.

The codec reads the same members as above. These fixtures carry no generationConfig member, so no response schema.

Files, with the request target and the credential header as captured:

opencode1-first-turn.json     POST /v1beta/models/scripted-model:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse    x-goog-api-key = sentinel
opencode1-second-turn.json    POST /v1beta/models/scripted-model:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse    x-goog-api-key = sentinel; carries one functionResponse (name read)
opencode2-first-turn.json     POST /v1beta/models/scripted-model:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse    x-goog-api-key = sentinel
opencode2-second-turn.json    POST /v1beta/models/scripted-model:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse    x-goog-api-key = sentinel; carries one functionResponse (name read, id tool_d93326fdd356418cb07ef3b44d17b1d9)

Decoded values a test can assert:
- opencode1 first turn: one tools entry holding 10 declarations, first declared bash, read among them declaring its schema under parameters with required property filePath (type string); no tool results; streaming true; model scripted-model.
- opencode2 first turn: one tools entry holding 12 declarations, first declared edit, read among them declaring its schema under parametersJsonSchema with required property path (type string); no tool results; streaming true; model scripted-model.
- second turns: the same declarations as the first turn of the same major; exactly one tool result, Name read, Output the compact re-encoding of the response member (an object with the members name and content; content holds the file's text, whose last line carries the nonce).
- ReadFile selects the read declaration on both majors: it renames the argument to filePath on opencode1 and to path on opencode2.

Members dropped from every one of these fixtures:
- systemInstruction (whole member)
- toolConfig (opencode1 only; it held functionCallingConfig mode AUTO)
- generationConfig (whole member, where it held maxOutputTokens alone)
- contents[].parts[].text
- contents[].parts[].functionCall
- tools[].functionDeclarations[].description

Value replaced rather than dropped: in functionResponse.response.content of both second-turn fixtures the run's temporary workspace directory prefix is replaced by /workspace, so the value still carries the nonce and the file name. The replaced text sat inside a member the codec reads, so a test asserting Output asserts the text with /workspace in it.

Consequences of the reduction: the text parts and the model's functionCall part in contents remain as empty objects, so each second-turn fixture holds three contents entries with one part each, the last one the functionResponse. No captured header, sentinel, temporary path or system text remains in a fixture.

Members kept although the codec does not read them: contents[].role, functionResponse.id (opencode2 only), and the schema descriptions inside parameters and parametersJsonSchema, because those are part of the schema exactly as declared.
